[LTIM.10.10] **Coverage is the integrator's.** For each zone a program
resolves, the integrator should supply `TimeZoneOffset` facts covering every
instant the program resolves it at: in practice from the oldest timestamp its
data carries to a horizon past the present, extended before the last fact's
`valid_until` arrives. An instant no fact covers has no answer
([LTIM.10.5.3]), and the engine supplies none in its place ([LTIM.10.5.4]).
